name: Shadowy Rays
body:
School evocation [darkness, shadow]; Level death mage 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect 1 ray/2 levels (maximum 7 rays)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fire off dark inky rays of shadow from the shadow plane. You can fire one ray for every two caster levels you have, maximum seven rays. You can fire all the rays at once, or one bolt per round as a free action. You are not required to fire a ray in any one round, but if they are not used up within 1 minute, they are lost. If all rays are hurled at once, all targets must be within 60 feet of each other.

You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. On a hit the target takes 2d8 points of damage to a living creature, and the target must make a Will save or be dazed for 1 round. The dazing does not stack if hit by multiple rays. Undead creatures are not damaged but they are dazed, and constructs are unaffected altogether.
